scripts.kill: pkill -f vite 2>/dev/null; pkill -f tsx 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :3456 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo '✅ Killed vite and api processes'
scripts.docker:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U app -d aperture
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist node_modules && rm -rf node_modules
scripts.test:discovery: pnpm --filter './packages/*' run build && LOG_LEVEL=silent apps/api/node_modules/.bin/tsx --test packages/core/src/lib/asyncCache.test.ts packages/core/src/seerr/provider.test.ts packages/core/src/discover/sources.test.ts apps/api/src/routes/discovery/index.test.ts apps/web/src/pages/discovery/hooks/discoveryRequests.test.ts apps/web/src/pages/discovery/hooks/discoveryHooks.test.ts packages/core/src/discover/peopleBrowse.test.ts packages/core/src/justwatch/cache.test.ts apps/api/src/routes/discovery/stripLoading.test.ts apps/web/src/pages/discovery/hooks/stripLoading.test.ts
scripts.test:ui-performance: pnpm --filter @aperture/core build && LOG_LEVEL=silent apps/api/node_modules/.bin/tsx --tsconfig apps/web/tsconfig.json --test apps/web/src/hooks/userPreferences.test.ts apps/web/src/pages/settings/components/chatCost.test.ts apps/web/src/hooks/watchingCache.test.ts apps/web/src/hooks/activeJobs.test.ts apps/web/src/pages/browse/hooks/browseLoading.test.ts apps/web/src/pages/media-detail/hooks/mediaLoading.test.ts apps/web/src/pages/playlists/hooks/playlistLoading.test.ts apps/api/src/routes/uiReadPaths.test.ts apps/api/src/routes/users/handlers/profile/watchHistory.test.ts packages/core/src/tmdb/chartCache.test.ts packages/core/src/media/playlistPreview.test.ts apps/api/src/routes/media-proxy/images.test.ts
scripts.test:upcoming: pnpm --filter @aperture/core build && LOG_LEVEL=silent apps/api/node_modules/.bin/tsx --tsconfig apps/web/tsconfig.json --test packages/core/src/watching/upcomingEpisodes.test.ts apps/api/src/routes/watching/upcoming.test.ts apps/web/src/hooks/watchingUpcoming.test.ts apps/web/src/hooks/watchingCache.test.ts packages/core/src/tmdb/client.test.ts
scripts.test:encore: pnpm --filter @aperture/core build && pnpm --filter @aperture/mcp build && LOG_LEVEL=silent apps/api/node_modules/.bin/tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/api/src/routes/assistant/*.test.ts packages/core/src/lib/ai-reasoning.test.ts
scripts.test:schemas: pnpm --filter @aperture/core build && LOG_LEVEL=silent apps/api/node_modules/.bin/tsx --test apps/api/src/schemaCompliance.test.ts apps/api/src/contracts/*.test.ts packages/core/src/lib/libraryTitles.test.ts packages/core/src/media/emby/libraries.test.ts
scripts.test:emby-stability: pnpm --filter @aperture/core build && LOG_LEVEL=silent apps/api/node_modules/.bin/tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/core/src/strm/incrementalOutput.test.ts packages/core/src/strm/publishing.test.ts packages/core/src/media/emby/libraries.test.ts packages/core/src/media/emby/base.test.ts packages/core/src/media/emby/refreshQueue.test.ts packages/core/src/lib/workQueue.test.ts packages/core/src/jobs/jobConfig.test.ts apps/api/src/lib/mediaServerJobs.test.ts
scripts.test:job-schedules: pnpm --filter @aperture/core build && LOG_LEVEL=silent apps/api/node_modules/.bin/tsx --tsconfig apps/web/tsconfig.json --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/core/src/jobs/nextRun.test.ts packages/core/src/jobs/jobConfigUpdates.test.ts apps/web/src/pages/jobs/scheduleTiming.test.ts apps/api/src/lib/scheduler.test.ts
